verdict.rationale: Kino AI is an agent-integrated video editor that runs an MCP server, so shipping installable agent skills is a plausible capability and the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a skills collection or selective skill installation. The 100+ templates you can 'bring in' are an adjacent feature (editing assets), not selectable agent skills.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install only the specific skills I want from a collection instead of taking the whole bundle
